calibration_sources: Inception Labs Mercury Coder (Commercial Diffusion Large Language Models at >1,000 tokens/sec on H100)
Block Diffusion (BD3-LMs: Interpolating Between Autoregressive and Discrete Diffusion Language Models with KV Caching)
LLaDA (Large Language Diffusion with mAsking) & MDLM (Masked Diffusion Language Models) Benchmarks

workload.hardware_and_model: 1x NVIDIA H100 SXM5 (3.35 TB/s HBM3, 989 TFLOPS BF16/FP8) serving an 8B-Class Code/Text Model
workload.generation_profile: 4,096-token input context (repo file) -> 512-token code completion / infilling output
workload.roofline_physics: Autoregressive BS=1 reads 8GB weights 512 times (1.8% Tensor Core util); Block Diffusion unmasks 16-20 tokens/step in parallel on Tensor Cores

tiers.name: Tier 1: 标准自回归 (AR) 逐词串行解码 (生成 512 词需重读 512 次权重 -> 仅 112 tok/s)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Standard Autoregressive (AR) Token-by-Token Decode (512 Weight Reads -> 112 tok/s)
tiers.attention_and_caching_mechanism: Causal left-to-right mask + full KV cache, but generates strictly 1 token per forward pass
tiers.roofline_and_infilling_behavior: 100% HBM memory-bandwidth bound (Tensor Core util = 1.8%); requires FIM hack for middle infilling
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy baseline or unconstrained short chat where latency > 4.5s for 512 tokens is acceptable.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 自回归 + EAGLE-3 投机解码 (单步验证 4~5 词 -> 285 tok/s，但受限于串行左到右因果链)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Autoregressive + EAGLE-3 Speculative Decoding (285 tok/s · Left-to-Right Bound)
tiers.attention_and_caching_mechanism: Lightweight draft head proposes 5-token tree verified in 1 target pass (avg ~2.6-3.2 accepted)
tiers.roofline_and_infilling_behavior: Speeds up AR by 2.54x, but still requires ~180 weight reads and cannot unmask 16+ tokens per step
tiers.recommended_for: Drop-in acceleration for existing autoregressive foundation models (Llama-3/Qwen/DeepSeek) without retraining.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 全序列无缓存掩码扩散 (原版 LLaDA / MDLM -> 无因果掩码导致无法用 KV Cache，长上下文反变慢)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Naive Full-Sequence Masked Diffusion (Vanilla LLaDA/MDLM · No KV Cache)
tiers.attention_and_caching_mechanism: Full bidirectional attention over all 4,608 tokens (4,096 prompt + 512 masked) across 32 denoising steps
tiers.roofline_and_infilling_behavior: Only 32 steps, BUT recomputing the 4,096-token prompt KV 32 times makes it slower than EAGLE-3 at 4K context!
tiers.recommended_for: Short-prompt (<256 token) unconditional bidirectional text generation and academic diffusion studies.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 分块半自回归扩散 + 跨块 KV Cache + 置信度动态早停 (BD3-LM / Inception Mercury Coder 范式)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Block Diffusion (BD3-LM / Mercury) + Inter-Block KV Cache + Confidence Early-Exit
tiers.attention_and_caching_mechanism: Causal KV Cache across 4K prompt & prior blocks + bidirectional parallel denoising inside 128-token active block
tiers.roofline_and_infilling_behavior: Unmasks ~18 tokens/step in 28 total steps (5.8 steps/block via p>0.96 early exit), reaching 1,180 tok/s!
tiers.recommended_for: Ultra-fast IDE code completion/editing (Cursor/Copilot), structured JSON generation, and real-time voice/agent loops (>1,000 tok/s).
